rows.query: SELECT tenant_area_add($1, date_trunc($4, now() AT TIME ZONE $5)::date, $2, $3)
SELECT job_id, count(*) n, ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry)) x, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry)) y FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) GROUP BY 1

WITH t AS (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope($1, $2, $3) AS e), s AS ( SELECT ST_Transform(f.geom, $10) AS g3, f.cls  FROM national_faces f, t WHERE f.asset=$4 AND f.year=$5 AND f.lvl=$8 AND f.geom && ST_Transform(t.e, $11)  AND (EXISTS (SELECT $12 FROM national_cells c WHERE c.asset=f.asset AND c.year=f.year AND c.cell_cd=f.cell_cd AND c.state=$13 AND NOT c.test)       OR ($6 AND f.cell_cd LIKE $14))), q AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(s.g3, $7), t.e, $15, $16, $17) AS g, s.cls FROM s, t WHERE ST_Area(s.g3) >= $9) SELECT ST_AsMVT(q, $18, $19, $20) FROM q WHERE g IS NOT NULL

WITH ev AS (SELECT job_id, sum(amount) AS amt FROM usage_events WHERE at >= $1 AND dim = 'area_km2' AND tenant_id = $2 GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT ev.job_id, ev.amt, CASE WHEN j.aoi IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN i.footprint IS NULL THEN ST_MakeValid(j.aoi) ELSE ST_Intersection(ST_MakeValid(j.aoi), ST_MakeValid(i.footprint)) END AS geom FROM ev LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = ev.job_id LEFT JOIN imagery i ON i.id = j.imagery_id), agg AS (SELECT ST_Union(geom) FILTER (WHERE geom IS NOT NULL) AS u, coalesce(sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE geom IS NULL), 0) AS extra, array_agg(job_id) AS ids FROM g), del AS (DELETE FROM tenant_area_parts WHERE tenant_id = $2 AND month = $3), parts AS (INSERT INTO tenant_area_parts(tenant_id, month, geom, area_km2) SELECT $2, $3, d.geom, ST_Area(d.geom::geography) / 1e6 FROM agg, ST_Dump(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(agg.u), 3)) d WHERE agg.u IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(d.geom) RETURNING area_km2), jj AS (INSERT INTO tenant_area_jobs(tenant_id, month, job_id) SELECT $2, $3, x FROM agg, unnest(agg.ids) x WHERE x IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) INSERT INTO tenant_area_month(tenant_id, month, geom, extra_km2, area_km2, jobs, updated_at) SELECT $2, $3, NULL, extra, (SELECT coalesce(sum(area_km2), 0) FROM parts) + extra, coalesce(array_length(ids, 1), 0), now() FROM agg ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, month) DO UPDATE SET geom = NULL, extra_km2 = EXCLUDED.extra_km2, area_km2 = EXCLUDED.area_km2, jobs = EXCLUDED.jobs, updated_at = now() RETURNING area_km2
SELECT id, job_id, ST_X(p), ST_Y(p) FROM (SELECT id, job_id, ST_PointOnSurface(geom) p FROM detections WHERE (emd IS NULL OR emd = $2) LIMIT $1) q
SELECT sgg_cd sgg, count(*) n FROM survey_parcels WHERE sgg_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.sgg_cd, s.tenant_id, s.state, coalesce(s.finished_at, s.at) AS at, coalesce(c.findings, $3) AS findings, coalesce(c.field_check, $4) AS field_check, coalesce(c.review_pending, $5) AS review_pending FROM survey_sgg s LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.sgg_cd, sum(g.n)::bigint AS findings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.fc) AS field_check, sum(g.rp)::bigint AS review_pending FROM (SELECT f.sgg_cd, f.pnu, count(*) AS n, bool_or(f.priority = $6 AND f.state IN ($7,$8)) AS fc, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.priority = $9 AND f.state = $10) AS rp FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND ($2::text[] IS NULL OR f.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = f.pnu AND d1.rule = f.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (f.priority, f.card_id IS NOT NULL, f.id)) GROUP BY f.sgg_cd, f.pnu) g GROUP BY g.sgg_cd) c ON c.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd WHERE ($2::text[] IS NULL OR s.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) ORDER BY s.sgg_cd
COPY detections (tenant_id, job_id, shard_id, fid, cls, cls_en, cid, conf, area_m2, chip_edge, edit_state, geom) FROM STDIN
SELECT id, job_id, ST_X(p), ST_Y(p) FROM (SELECT id, job_id, ST_PointOnSurface(geom) p FROM detections WHERE (emd IS NULL OR emd = $2) LIMIT $1) q
COPY detections (tenant_id, job_id, shard_id, fid, cls, cls_en, cid, conf, area_m2, emd, emd_cd, chip_edge, edit_state, geom) FROM STDIN

SELECT j.id, j.options->>$3 AS sgg, j.submitted_by, j.finished_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.kind = $4 AND j.state = $5 AND j.options->>$6 = $7 AND NOT j.demo AND NOT coalesce(j.test, $8) AND j.deploy_id IS NULL AND j.finished_at > greatest(now() - make_interval(hours => $1), to_timestamp($2)) AND EXISTS (SELECT $9 FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = j.id) ORDER BY j.finished_at
SELECT jimok, cls_ko, count(DISTINCT pnu)::int AS n FROM survey_parcel_ai WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND job_id = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT jimok, count(*)::int AS n, sum(area_m2) AS m2, count(jiga)::int AS nj, percentile_cont($2) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jiga) FILTER (WHERE jiga > $3) AS jiga_med FROM survey_parcels WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT jimok, count(DISTINCT pnu)::int AS n FROM survey_parcel_ai WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND job_id = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT job_id, count(*) n, ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry)) x, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry)) y FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT cell_cd, ST_AsBinary(geom_s) FROM national_cells WHERE asset=$1 AND year=$2 AND NOT test AND state <> $3 AND geom_s IS NOT NULL
SELECT id, state, created_at FROM jobs WHERE (kind=$3 OR (kind=$4 AND options ? $5)) AND options->>$6 = $1 AND created_at >= $2 AND NOT coalesce(test,$7) ORDER BY created_at DESC
UPDATE survey_parcels SET tenant_id = $1 WHERE tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2
SELECT sgg_cd sgg, count(*) n FROM survey_parcels WHERE sgg_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT job_id, floor(((ST_XMin(geom) + ST_XMax(geom)) / $5) / $2)::int AS gx, floor(((ST_YMin(geom) + ST_YMax(geom)) / $6) / $2)::int AS gy, count(*)::int AS n FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND coalesce(edit_state, $7) <> $8 AND geom IS NOT NULL  AND NOT (job_id = $3 AND coalesce(cls, $9) <> ALL($4::text[])) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

WITH t AS (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope($1, $2, $3) AS e), q AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Transform(c.geom_s, $7), $6), t.e, $8, $9, $10) AS g, c.cell_cd AS cd,  (c.state=$11)::int AS done, c.sido, c.sgg_name AS sgg, c.name,  CASE WHEN c.state=$12 THEN (c.counts->$13->>$14)::int END AS n1, CASE WHEN c.state=$15 THEN (c.counts->$16->>$17)::float END AS a1,  CASE WHEN c.state=$18 THEN (c.counts->$19->>$20)::int END AS n2, CASE WHEN c.state=$21 THEN (c.counts->$22->>$23)::int END AS n3,  (SELECT i.ratio::float FROM national_imgcover i WHERE i.year=c.year AND i.cell_cd=c.cell_cd AND i.kind=$24) AS noimg,  (SELECT i.fill_year FROM national_imgcover i WHERE i.year=c.year AND i.cell_cd=c.cell_cd AND i.kind=$25 AND i.applied_at IS NOT NULL) AS fill  FROM national_cells c, t WHERE c.asset=$4 AND c.year=$5 AND NOT c.test AND c.state<>$26 AND c.geom_s && ST_Transform(t.e, $27)) SELECT ST_AsMVT(q, $28, $29, $30) FROM q WHERE g IS NOT NULL

SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(r.*)),$3) FROM registry_snapshots r WHERE r.tenant_id=$1) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(f.*)),$4) FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.tenant_id=$1) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(d.*)),$5) FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = ANY($2::text[])) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(x.*)),$6) FROM index_results x WHERE x.job_id = ANY($2::text[]))
SELECT DISTINCT emd AS w FROM survey_parcels WHERE emd IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT ri AS w FROM survey_parcels WHERE ri IS NOT NULL AND ri <> $1

SELECT j.id, j.options->>$3 AS sgg, j.submitted_by, j.finished_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.kind = $4 AND j.state = $5 AND j.options->>$6 = $7 AND NOT j.demo AND NOT coalesce(j.test, $8) AND j.deploy_id IS NULL AND j.finished_at > greatest(now() - make_interval(hours => $1), to_timestamp($2)) AND EXISTS (SELECT $9 FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = j.id) ORDER BY j.finished_at

SELECT s.sgg_cd, s.tenant_id, s.state, coalesce(s.finished_at, s.at) AS at, coalesce(c.findings, $3) AS findings, coalesce(c.field_check, $4) AS field_check, coalesce(c.review_pending, $5) AS review_pending FROM survey_sgg s LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.sgg_cd, sum(g.n)::bigint AS findings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.fc) AS field_check, sum(g.rp)::bigint AS review_pending FROM (SELECT f.sgg_cd, f.pnu, count(*) AS n, bool_or(f.priority = $6 AND f.state IN ($7,$8)) AS fc, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.priority = $9 AND f.state = $10) AS rp FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND ($2::text[] IS NULL OR f.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = f.pnu AND d1.rule = f.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (f.priority, f.card_id IS NOT NULL, f.id)) GROUP BY f.sgg_cd, f.pnu) g GROUP BY g.sgg_cd) c ON c.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd WHERE ($2::text[] IS NULL OR s.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) ORDER BY s.sgg_cd
SELECT jimok, cls_ko, count(DISTINCT pnu)::int AS n FROM survey_parcel_ai WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND job_id = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT emd_cd, rule, priority, state, count(*) n FROM survey_findings WHERE rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $2 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = survey_findings.pnu AND d1.rule = survey_findings.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (survey_findings.priority, survey_findings.card_id IS NOT NULL, survey_findings.id)) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.set_id, e.fid) e.id, e.set_id, e.fid, e.action, e.cls_before, e.cls_after, e.memo, e.test, e.at, ST_AsGeoJSON(coalesce(e.geom_after, d.geom, e.geom_before), $3)::json AS g, ST_AsGeoJSON(e.geom_before, $4)::json AS g0 FROM result_edits e LEFT JOIN detections d ON d.id = e.det_id WHERE e.undone_at IS NULL AND (e.set_id = ANY($1::text[]) OR ($2::float8[] IS NOT NULL AND e.set_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM national_jobs)     AND coalesce(e.geom_after, e.geom_before) && ST_MakeEnvelope($2[$5], $2[$6], $2[$7], $2[$8], $9))) ORDER BY e.set_id, e.fid, e.at DESC

SELECT id, name, tier, gsd_m, epoch, crs, pmtiles_set, xyz_folder, license, attribution, export_policy, security_review, rights_holder, asset_ref, ladder, kind, layer, sgg_cd, tile_job_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(footprint)::json AS fp, CASE WHEN footprint IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE ARRAY[ST_XMin(footprint), ST_YMin(footprint), ST_XMax(footprint), ST_YMax(footprint)] END AS bb FROM imagery

SELECT jimok, count(*)::int AS n, sum(area_m2) AS m2, count(jiga)::int AS nj, percentile_cont($2) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jiga) FILTER (WHERE jiga > $3) AS jiga_med FROM survey_parcels WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT cls FROM detections WHERE job_id=$1 AND cls IS NOT NULL

SELECT job_id, emd_cd, max(emd) AS emd, count(*)::int AS n FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND coalesce(edit_state,$4) <> $5 AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL AND NOT (job_id = $2 AND coalesce(cls, $6) <> ALL($3::text[])) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT j.id, j.card_id, j.imagery_id, j.finished_at, i.sgg_cd AS isgg, i.year AS iyear, i.epoch, i.name AS iname FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN imagery i ON i.id = j.imagery_id WHERE j.state = $1 AND NOT coalesce(j.test, $2) AND j.id LIKE $3

SELECT j.id, j.options->>$1 AS sgg_cd, j.imagery_id, j.model_id, j.options->$2 AS ocls, j.finished_at, m.classes, i.year FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN models m ON m.id = j.model_id LEFT JOIN imagery i ON i.id = j.imagery_id WHERE j.kind=$3 AND j.state=$4 AND NOT j.demo AND NOT coalesce(j.test,$5) AND j.snapshot_ready AND j.card_id IS NULL AND j.tenant_id=$6 AND j.options->>$7=$8 ORDER BY j.finished_at DESC

SELECT s.sgg_cd, s.tenant_id, s.state, coalesce(s.finished_at, s.at) AS at, coalesce(c.findings, $3) AS findings, coalesce(c.field_check, $4) AS field_check, coalesce(c.review_pending, $5) AS review_pending FROM survey_sgg s LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.sgg_cd, sum(g.n)::bigint AS findings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.fc) AS field_check, sum(g.rp)::bigint AS review_pending FROM (SELECT f.sgg_cd, f.pnu, count(*) AS n, bool_or(f.priority = $6 AND f.state IN ($7,$8)) AS fc, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.priority = $9 AND f.state = $10) AS rp FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND ($2::text[] IS NULL OR f.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = f.pnu AND d1.rule = f.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (f.priority, f.card_id IS NOT NULL, f.id)) GROUP BY f.sgg_cd, f.pnu) g GROUP BY g.sgg_cd) c ON c.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd WHERE ($2::text[] IS NULL OR s.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) ORDER BY s.sgg_cd
SELECT jimok, count(DISTINCT pnu)::int AS n FROM survey_parcel_ai WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND job_id = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM survey_parcels WHERE substr(pnu,$2,$3) = ANY($1::text[])

INSERT INTO national_faces(asset, year, cell_cd, lvl, cls, geom) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, cls, ST_Multi(ST_Union(ST_MakeEnvelope(gx * $11, gy * $12, gx * $13 + $14, gy * $15 + $16, $17))) FROM ( SELECT d.cls, floor(ST_X(ST_PointOnSurface(d.geom)) / $18)::int gx, floor(ST_Y(ST_PointOnSurface(d.geom)) / $19)::int gy, sum(d.area_m2) a  FROM detections d JOIN national_cells n ON n.asset=$5 AND n.year=$6 AND n.cell_cd=$7 WHERE d.job_id = ANY($8) AND d.cls = ANY($9) AND coalesce(d.edit_state, $20) <> $21 AND ST_Intersects(n.geom_s, ST_PointOnSurface(d.geom)) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) q WHERE a >= $10 GROUP BY cls

SELECT j.card_id, j.options->>$1 AS sgg, j.options->>$2 AS cov, j.perf->>$3 AS el, j.finished_at, i.year AS iyear, i.gsd_m AS igsd FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN imagery i ON i.id=j.imagery_id WHERE j.card_id IS NOT NULL AND j.state=$4 AND j.options->>$5=$6 AND NOT coalesce(j.test,$7) AND NOT coalesce(j.demo,$8) AND j.perf ? $9 ORDER BY j.finished_at DESC
SELECT job_id, count(*) AS n FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND cls = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT cls FROM detections WHERE cls IS NOT NULL

SELECT j.id, j.card_id, j.submitted_by, j.finished_at, j.options->>$2 AS sgg FROM jobs j WHERE j.kind=$3 AND j.state=$4 AND NOT coalesce(j.test, $5) AND j.deploy_id IS NULL AND j.card_id IS NOT NULL AND j.options->>$6=$7 AND coalesce(j.options->>$8,$9) <> $10 AND j.finished_at > now() - make_interval(hours => $1) AND EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = j.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $12 FROM jobs s WHERE s.kind=$13 AND s.options->>$14 = j.id) ORDER BY j.finished_at ASC LIMIT $15
SELECT count(*) FROM survey_parcels WHERE substr(pnu,$2,$3) = ANY($1::text[])

SELECT j.id, j.tenant_id, j.result_set, j.model_id, j.imagery_id, j.finished_at, j.counts, j.card_id, j.options, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Envelope(j.aoi))::json AS env, m.classes, i.year, i.epoch FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN models m ON m.id=j.model_id LEFT JOIN imagery i ON i.id=j.imagery_id WHERE j.kind=$2 AND j.state=$3 AND NOT j.demo AND NOT coalesce(j.test,$4) AND j.snapshot_ready AND j.options->>$5=$6 AND j.options->>$7 = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY j.finished_at DESC LIMIT $8

SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(r.*)),$3) FROM registry_snapshots r WHERE r.tenant_id=$1) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(f.*)),$4) FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.tenant_id=$1) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(d.*)),$5) FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = ANY($2::text[])) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(x.*)),$6) FROM index_results x WHERE x.job_id = ANY($2::text[]))

SELECT rule, priority, count(*) n FROM survey_findings WHERE rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $2 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = survey_findings.pnu AND d1.rule = survey_findings.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (survey_findings.priority, survey_findings.card_id IS NOT NULL, survey_findings.id)) GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE state=$1)::text || $2 || coalesce((SELECT max(finished_at) FROM jobs WHERE state=$3)::text, $4) || $5 || (SELECT count(*) FROM imagery)::text
DELETE FROM detections WHERE job_id=$1
SELECT pool, percentile_cont($1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract($2 FROM started_at-created_at)) p95 FROM jobs WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at > now() - interval $3 GROUP BY 1

SELECT j.id, j.card_id, j.submitted_by, j.finished_at, j.options->>$2 AS sgg FROM jobs j WHERE j.kind=$3 AND j.state=$4 AND NOT coalesce(j.test, $5) AND j.deploy_id IS NULL AND j.card_id IS NOT NULL AND j.options->>$6=$7 AND coalesce(j.options->>$8,$9) <> $10 AND j.finished_at > now() - make_interval(hours => $1) AND EXISTS (SELECT $11 FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id = j.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $12 FROM jobs s WHERE s.kind=$13 AND s.options->>$14 = j.id) ORDER BY j.finished_at ASC LIMIT $15

SELECT j.id, j.tenant_id, j.result_set FROM jobs j WHERE NOT j.demo AND (CASE WHEN j.tenant_id <> $2 THEN coalesce((SELECT d.tenant_id FROM deploys d WHERE d.id = j.deploy_id), j.tenant_id)
  ELSE j.tenant_id END) = $1

SELECT d.job_id, c.cell_cd AS emd_cd, max(c.name) AS emd, count(*)::int AS n FROM detections d JOIN national_cells c ON c.asset=$5 AND c.year=$2 AND NOT c.test AND ST_Intersects(c.geom_s, ST_PointOnSurface(d.geom)) WHERE d.job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND coalesce(d.edit_state,$6) <> $7 AND d.emd_cd IS NULL AND d.geom IS NOT NULL AND NOT (d.job_id = $3 AND coalesce(d.cls, $8) <> ALL($4::text[])) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT state, rule, count(*) n FROM survey_findings WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT $1 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = survey_findings.pnu AND d1.rule = survey_findings.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (survey_findings.priority, survey_findings.card_id IS NOT NULL, survey_findings.id)) GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT d.job_id, count(*) FROM detections d JOIN deploys p ON p.snapshot_current = $1 || p.tenant_id || $2 || d.job_id OR p.snapshot_current = $3 || d.job_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT u.tenant_id AS t, u.dim, sum(u.amount) AS v FROM usage_events u WHERE u.at >= $1 AND u.dim = ANY($2::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT asset, k AS cls, sum((v->>$2)::bigint) AS n, sum((v->>$3)::numeric) AS km2 FROM national_cells, jsonb_each(counts) AS e(k, v) WHERE year=$1 AND NOT test AND state=$4 GROUP BY asset, k

UPDATE jobs SET state=$1, shards_total=$2, shards_done=$3, shards_failed=$4, counts=$5, gpu_s=$6, workers=$7, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, $8::timestamptz), error=COALESCE($9::text, error), finished_at=CASE WHEN $10::text IN ($12,$13) THEN COALESCE(finished_at, now()) ELSE finished_at END WHERE id=$11 AND state NOT IN ($14,$15,$16)

SELECT asset, count(*) FILTER (WHERE model_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AS cur, count(*) FILTER (WHERE model_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2) AS old, coalesce(sum(target_km2) FILTER (WHERE model_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2),$3) AS old_km2 FROM national_cells WHERE year=$1 AND NOT test AND state=$4 GROUP BY asset

WITH t AS (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope($1, $2, $3) AS e), q AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Transform(c.geom_s, $7), $6), t.e, $8, $9, $10) AS g, c.cell_cd AS cd,  (c.state=$11)::int AS done, c.sido, c.sgg_name AS sgg, c.name,  CASE WHEN c.state=$12 THEN (c.counts->$13->>$14)::int END AS n1, CASE WHEN c.state=$15 THEN (c.counts->$16->>$17)::float END AS a1,  CASE WHEN c.state=$18 THEN (c.counts->$19->>$20)::int END AS n2, CASE WHEN c.state=$21 THEN (c.counts->$22->>$23)::int END AS n3  FROM national_cells c, t WHERE c.asset=$4 AND c.year=$5 AND NOT c.test AND c.state<>$24 AND c.geom_s && ST_Transform(t.e, $25)) SELECT ST_AsMVT(q, $26, $27, $28) FROM q WHERE g IS NOT NULL

SELECT job_id, floor(((ST_XMin(geom) + ST_XMax(geom)) / $5) / $2)::int AS gx, floor(((ST_YMin(geom) + ST_YMax(geom)) / $6) / $2)::int AS gy, count(*)::int AS n FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND coalesce(edit_state, $7) <> $8 AND geom IS NOT NULL  AND NOT (job_id = $3 AND coalesce(cls, $9) <> ALL($4::text[])) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT s.sgg_cd, s.tenant_id, s.state, coalesce(s.finished_at, s.at) AS at, (SELECT count(*) FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd AND f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND f.card_id IS NULL) AS findings, (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.pnu) FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd AND f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND f.card_id IS NULL AND f.priority = $3 AND f.state IN ($4,$5)) AS field_check, (SELECT count(*) FROM survey_findings f WHERE f.sgg_cd = s.sgg_cd AND f.rule = ANY($1::text[]) AND f.card_id IS NULL AND f.priority = $6 AND f.state = $7) AS review_pending FROM survey_sgg s WHERE ($2::text[] IS NULL OR s.sgg_cd = ANY($2::text[])) ORDER BY s.sgg_cd
SELECT DISTINCT emd, ri, substr(pnu,$1,$2) p10 FROM survey_parcels

SELECT emd_cd, count(*)::int AS n FROM survey_findings WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND rule = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $3 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = survey_findings.pnu AND d1.rule = survey_findings.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (survey_findings.priority, survey_findings.card_id IS NOT NULL, survey_findings.id)) GROUP BY 1
SELECT job_id, emd_cd, max(emd) AS emd, count(*)::int AS n FROM detections WHERE job_id = ANY($1::text[]) AND coalesce(edit_state,$2) <> $3 AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT emd_cd, max(emd) AS emd, rule, count(*)::int AS n FROM survey_findings WHERE sgg_cd = ANY($1::text[]) AND rule = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT $3 FROM survey_findings d1 WHERE d1.pnu = survey_findings.pnu AND d1.rule = survey_findings.rule AND (d1.priority, d1.card_id IS NOT NULL, d1.id) < (survey_findings.priority, survey_findings.card_id IS NOT NULL, survey_findings.id)) GROUP BY 1, 3

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.pnu) f.*, p.jibun, p.ri, (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT g.rule ORDER BY g.rule) FROM survey_findings g WHERE g.pnu = f.pnu AND g.rule = ANY($1)) AS rules_all, (SELECT count(*) FROM survey_timeline t, jsonb_array_elements(t.events) ev WHERE t.pnu = f.pnu AND ev->>$5 = $6) AS n_change FROM survey_findings f LEFT JOIN survey_parcels p USING (pnu) WHERE f.sgg_cd=$2 AND f.rule = ANY($3) ORDER BY f.pnu, f.score DESC, f.rank) x ORDER BY x.score DESC, x.rank LIMIT $4

SELECT emd_cd, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY emd), count(*), sum(area_m2) / $3, count(*) FILTER (WHERE jimok = ANY($1)), ST_XMin(ST_Extent(geom)), ST_YMin(ST_Extent(geom)), ST_XMax(ST_Extent(geom)), ST_YMax(ST_Extent(geom)) FROM survey_parcels WHERE sgg_cd = $2 GROUP BY emd_cd
SELECT pnu FROM survey_parcels

SELECT d.id, d.fid, d.cls, d.cls_en, d.cid, d.conf, d.area_m2, d.edit_state, d.tenant_id, d.emd, ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geom, $3)::json AS g, ST_NPoints(d.geom) AS nv FROM detections d WHERE d.job_id=$1 AND (d.fid=$2 OR d.id::text=$2) LIMIT $4

SELECT pnu, jibun, jimok, jimok_nm, area_m2, jiga, jiga_ym, emd, emd_cd, ri, sgg_cd, src, src_as_of, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, $3)::json AS g FROM survey_parcels WHERE geom && ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$4) AND ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$5)) LIMIT $6
SELECT d.job_id, count(*) FROM detections d JOIN deploys p ON p.snapshot_current = $1 || p.tenant_id || $2 || d.job_id OR p.snapshot_current = $3 || d.job_id GROUP BY 1
CALL lx_tenant_role_sync(NULL)
SELECT pnu FROM survey_parcels
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state=$1) f, count(*) n FROM jobs WHERE created_at > now() - interval $2
SELECT $1 FROM jobs WHERE kind=$2 AND state IN ($3,$4) AND options->>$5=$6 LIMIT $7
